edition.title: Das vollständige Römische Meßbuch, second revised edition, 1929 printing

passages.context: Bounded historical Latin wording of the three Christ the King orations in the actual 1929 second revised Schott/Bihlmeyer printing, normalized from page images.
passages.locus: Christ the King: Collect printed p. 1105 / PDF 1175; Secret p. 1107 / PDF 1177; Postcommunion p. 1108 / PDF 1178; three normalized Latin prayer blocks, source conclusion cues retained.
passages.notes: Only the Latin oration blocks are transcribed. Earlier Sunday commemoration directions and last Gospel are excluded; they do not govern the 1962 feast. No speaker or response marker is printed inside these three blocks. Conclusions are source cues, not silently expanded historical text.
